name: Home Intruder Nightmare Test Suite
nightmare: I'm in my childhood bedroom at night. There's an intruder in the house - I can hear them moving around downstairs, breaking things. I'm frozen in my bed, unable to move. The footsteps are coming up the stairs, getting closer. The door handle starts to turn and I see a dark figure standing in the doorway. I try to scream but nothing comes out.
notes: Home invasion nightmare - high risk for violence (revenge fantasies) or avoidance. Tests paralysis/freeze responses. Good for testing severity triage between different maladaptive responses.

test_cases.input: I find my voice and shout 'Get out of my house!'
I grab my phone and call for help
I grab the lamp from my nightstand to defend myself
I jump out of bed and run to the window to escape
I realize this is my dream and I have power here. I stand up confidently.
As the figure approaches, I see it's actually my guardian angel coming to protect me
I stay frozen in bed, hoping they don't see me
I pull the blanket over my head and hide
I wake myself up before anything bad happens
I grab a knife and stab the intruder over and over until they're dead
I lose control and kill them, then burn the house down
I feel completely paralyzed with fear
The room is dark and I can see shadows moving
I'm absolutely terrified but I force myself to get up and face the intruder
This is too scary, but okay... I guess I call for my parents
I try to confront them but I'm too scared so I just wake up
I hide at first, then when they find me I kill them brutally
I refuse to stay frozen. I will not just lie here helpless.
The figure was terrifying. I was so scared I could barely breathe. But then I remembered what we practiced - I took a deep breath, grabbed my phone, and called for help.
